notes.title: New name - Police Simulator: Patrol Duty
notes.content:
[h1]Dear POLICE fans[/h1], 

A few of you have already noticed some first changes happening on the Steam page of POLICE SIMULATOR 18. If your sleuthing instincts are telling you that this might have something to do with an imminent release of the game, congratulations: you are absolutely right! Due to the advanced time, POLICE Simulator 18 will be published under a new name “Police Simulator: Patrol Duty” and released exclusively on Steam on June 18, 2019. 

Those of you who have closely followed the development already know that due to severe technical problems the release of POLICE SIMULATOR had to be delayed month by month. There are also some features that were initially intended to become part of the game that have proven to be a greater challenge in the development process than originally estimated which in turn made an adjustment of the game’s scope a necessity. In “Police Simulator: Patrol Duty” you will now experience the normal everyday tasks of a police officer that include, for example, issuing parking tickets, recording accidents, questioning witnesses, gathering evidence on crime scenes and checking the identity of persons and vehicles. Simply put: a classic job simulator, so please do not expect SWAT missions or something similar action packed. It will also unfortunately not be possible to include further features beyond the already existing ones. Because of this changed feature set, the game will be available for 14.99 Euro/17.99 USD/13.49 GBP exclusively on Steam starting June 18, 2019.  

[u]Your POLICE Team[/u]

notes.title: POLICE SIMULATOR 18 - The current state of things
notes.content:
[h1]Hello police fans,[/h1] 

Thank you very much for your patience while waiting for news about POLICE SIMULATOR 18. Please excuse our long silence. We have been busily working on the game, so please don’t worry that it has been discontinued. That is very much not the case. 

There have been, however, some unforeseen technical roadblocks, that have prevented us from giving you further insights into our work as we had originally planned to do. Ironing these problems out is of course our top priority, as we want to release a game that is running as smoothly as possible. 

This is why we will unfortunately and to our greatest regret not be able to start up our news cycle once more at this point of time. While we are still aiming for a release towards the end of summer 2018, we cannot provide you with a release date yet due to the difficulties we are currently experiencing. We are aware that all of you who have been looking forward to POLICE SIMULATOR 18 would have wished for some different news today and can only offer our sincerest apologies. 

Thank you once more for your great support and love towards our game. We hope to be back with better news rather sooner than later.

Your POLICE SIMULATOR 18 team

notes.title: POLICE SIMULATOR 18 - release to be postponed to summer 2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone! First, we would like to take the opportunity and thank you for your great support, encouragement and constructive criticism regarding the development of POLICE SIMULATOR 18 in the last few months. We have received a tremendous amount of very useful feedback from police fans all over the world. Thank you so much for this!

Which is what brings us to today's actual news: As we are striving to offer you a police simulation that fully matches your expectations, we have come to the conclusion that it will be beneficial for the game to extend its development by a few more months and add as many of your desired elements as possible. It is however therefore unavoidable to postpone the release of our game to summer 2018. As soon as there will be a new concrete release date, we will of course let you know at once.

We are very sorry to disappoint those of you who have eagerly awaited to play POLICE SIMULATOR 18 in January, but we hope to compensate this by giving you an even better gameplay experience in the summer.

Thank you very much for your understanding and please keep up the great support!

Your teams of Bigmoon and astragon
